title: DICTIONARYVAR group-360, invalid-route, and subordinate-order controls
mode: generated ASCII/Binary fast implementation slice informed by primary sources

sources.observation: DICTIONARYVAR group 330 identifies its ACDBVARIABLEDICTIONARY owner.
The documented DICTIONARY entry pair uses group-3 key and group-350 soft-owner target.
The NOD is always the first OBJECTS record; subsequent non-graphical objects may be owned by it or by another object.
The parser accepts both 350 and 360 dictionary entry references, while the cited Autodesk schema documents 350. This is treated only as input-compatibility evidence.

planImpact.implementationSummary: Added generated ASCII/Binary controls for mixed 350/360 dictionary links; strict re-import/rewrite with explicit expected code selection (regenerated NOD entries use 350; ordinary child dictionary entries use 360 when hardOwner is 1, otherwise 350); subordinate record order variation with NOD first; and strict refusal of duplicate canonical root key, wrong target type, and missing target without replacing an existing destination.
